title: Poll
summary: Shows one poll: the question, the options with votes, the user's vote, and who voted for what when results are visible. A person votes or changes a vote here. The poll's creator ends it.

voteCount.description: Votes for this option, from the votes map. Absent while results are hidden.

voters.description: Who voted for this option, when results are visible. Empty while results are hidden.

isYourVote.description: true when the own user's vote is this option: bipe_app_poll_your_vote.

isWinner.description: Ended polls only: this option has the most votes (ties all count): bipe_app_poll_most_votes.

options.description: In the order the creator wrote them.

totalVotes.description: People who voted, for bipe_app_poll_votes. Absent while results are hidden.

resultsVisible.description: true when the kind is disclosed, or the poll has ended. Before the end of an undisclosed poll: bipe_app_poll_results_hidden.

isEnded.description: The poll has an end time: bipe_app_poll_ended, voting is off.

canEnd.description: The own user sent the poll and it has not ended.

vote.effect: Timeline.sendPollResponse with this one answer. Tapping the current vote again does nothing. A failure shows bipe_app_poll_vote_error and the old vote stays.

end.effect: Confirms with bipe_app_poll_end_confirm, then Timeline.endPoll with bipe_app_poll_ended_text as the text fallback.

notes: The poll comes from the timeline item with MsgLikeKind poll: question, kind, maxSelections, answers, votes (answer id to user ids) and endTime. The screen follows timeline updates, so new votes show live.
The same data draws the poll card in chat-timeline: the question, the options, the user's vote and, when results are visible, the counts. Tapping the card opens this screen.
Voters list the people by Person.displayName. In an undisclosed poll nobody sees votes before the end, the creator included.
Changing a vote sends a new response. Matrix counts the latest response of each person.
bipe_app_poll_votes takes the count, formatted by the platform.
